limits: AE is a separate integration trial, not a change to PT-Z-001 or UI-R-001.
Deck limits, unlocked set, concrete rewards, repeat points and upgrades are provisional.
No attribute quota is imposed. A chosen fixed size is a trial boundary, not a product size rule.
Automatic HP spends each 3 accumulated points immediately after settlement. Choice mode may buy either sample upgrade or retain points.
Equal prices are a wiring fixture, not a claim of balanced utility. Permanent reduction could suppress weak attacks.
The two sequential seeds are fixed before execution, without selecting successful endings. Human decisions and UI are not evaluated.
